decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector to the back edge resolves connector fit without changing the existing board orientation, USB-C placement, mounting-hole configuration, compactness goal, or aspect-ratio requirements.
The physical placement of the battery connector does not change the requirement for an NTC terminal on J_BAT or its thermal-protection function.
The battery connector placement decision does not alter the electrical protection controller or overcharge and overdischarge cutoff behavior.
The source decision concerns battery-connector placement and does not change charge-status display through the main-board SK6812 LED chain.
The moved battery connector is unrelated to I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up board location.
USB-C is used only as a placement reference; the decision does not change USB data lines, connector type, or sourceability.
Battery-connector placement does not affect the selected addressable LED family or its GPIO data interface.
The mechanical relocation of the battery connector does not change boost-rail enable control, converter configuration, powered loads, or usage pattern.
